sentences.zh: 後異論紛洄，復為《通難》示諸儒，諸儒不能詘。

translations.literal: Later divergent opinions swirled; he again wrote Difficulties Generalized to show the Confucians, and the Confucians could not refute him.
translations.idiomatic: Later divergent opinions swirled; he again wrote Difficulties Generalized to show the Confucians, and the Confucians could not refute him.

sentences.zh: 久之，典黔中選補，乘傳過家，西人以為榮。

translations.literal: After a long time he managed selection and appointment in Qianzhong; passing home by post carriage, western people took it as honor.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he managed selection and appointment in Qianzhong; passing home by post carriage, western people took it as honor.

sentences.zh: 終司門員外郎。

translations.literal: He ended as Assistant Master of the Gate Office.
translations.idiomatic: He ended as Assistant Master of the Gate Office.

sentences.zh: 子陵以文義自怡，及亡，其家所存，惟圖書及酒數斛而已。

translations.literal: Ziling found joy in literary meaning; at death what his household retained was only books and several hu of wine.
translations.idiomatic: Ziling found joy in literary meaning; at death what his household retained was only books and several hu of wine.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：《春秋》、《詩》、《易》、《書》，由孔子時師弟子相傳，歷暴秦，不斷如系。

translations.literal: The encomium reads: The Spring and Autumn Annals, Odes, Changes, and Documents were transmitted from master to disciple in Confucius's time; through violent Qin they did not break, like a thread tied fast.
translations.idiomatic: The encomium reads: The Spring and Autumn Annals, Odes, Changes, and Documents were transmitted from master to disciple in Confucius's time; through violent Qin they did not break, like a thread tied fast.

sentences.zh: 至漢興，刬挾書令，則儒者肆然講授，經典浸興。

translations.literal: When Han rose the proscription on books was abolished and Confucians freely lectured; the classics gradually flourished.
translations.idiomatic: When Han rose the proscription on books was abolished and Confucians freely lectured; the classics gradually flourished.

sentences.zh: 左氏與孔子同時，以《魯史》附《春秋》作《傳》，而公羊高、穀梁赤皆出子夏門人。

translations.literal: The Zuo Tradition was contemporary with Confucius; using Lu's history attached to the Spring and Autumn Annals it made a commentary; Gongyang Gao and Guliang Chi both came from Zixia's disciples.
translations.idiomatic: The Zuo Tradition was contemporary with Confucius; using Lu's history attached to the Spring and Autumn Annals it made a commentary; Gongyang Gao and Guliang Chi both came from Zixia's disciples.

sentences.zh: 三家言經，各有回舛，然猶悉本之聖人，其得與失蓋十五，義或繆誤，先儒畏聖人，不敢輒改也。

translations.literal: The three schools' explanations of the classics each had deviations, yet all fundamentally derived from the sage; gain and loss were perhaps five parts in fifteen; meanings might be erroneous, but early Confucians feared the sage and dared not rashly change.
translations.idiomatic: The three schools' explanations of the classics each had deviations, yet all fundamentally derived from the sage; gain and loss were perhaps five parts in fifteen; meanings might be erroneous, but early Confucians feared the sage and dared not rashly change.

sentences.zh: 啖助在唐，名治《春秋》，摭訕三家，不本所承，自用名學，憑私臆決，尊之曰「孔子意也」，趙、陸從而唱之，遂顯於時。

translations.literal: Tan Zhu in Tang was famed for mastering the Spring and Autumn Annals; he collected and mocked the three schools, not basing himself on what he received, using his own named learning and deciding by private speculation; honoring it he called it Confucius's intent; Zhao and Lu followed and proclaimed it, and it thereby shone in the age.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Zhu in Tang was famed for mastering the Spring and Autumn Annals; he collected and mocked the three schools, not basing himself on what he received, using his own named learning and deciding by private speculation; honoring it he called it Confucius's intent; Zhao and Lu followed and proclaimed it, and it thereby shone in the age.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 孔子沒乃數千年，助所推著果其意乎？

translations.literal: Confucius has been gone several thousand years—is what Zhu promoted and wrote truly his intent?
translations.idiomatic: Confucius has been gone several thousand years—is what Zhu promoted and wrote truly his intent?

sentences.zh: 其未可必也。

translations.literal: It cannot be certain.
translations.idiomatic: It cannot be certain.

sentences.zh: 以未可必而必之，則固；

translations.literal: To make certain what cannot be certain is obstinacy.
translations.idiomatic: To make certain what cannot be certain is obstinacy;

sentences.zh: 持一己之固而倡茲世，則誣。

translations.literal: to hold one's own obstinacy and proclaim it to this age is deception.
translations.idiomatic: to hold one's own obstinacy and proclaim it to this age is deception.

sentences.zh: 誣與固，君子所不取。

translations.literal: Deception and obstinacy are what the gentleman does not take.
translations.idiomatic: Deception and obstinacy are what the gentleman does not take.

sentences.zh: 助果謂可乎？

translations.literal: Did Zhu truly deem it acceptable?
translations.idiomatic: Did Zhu truly deem it acceptable?

sentences.zh: 徒令後生穿鑿詭辨，詬前人，舍成說，而自為紛紛，助所階已。

translations.literal: He merely made later students force interpretations and argue sophistry, revile predecessors, abandon established explanations, and create their own confusion—the step Zhu opened.
translations.idiomatic: He merely made later students force interpretations and argue sophistry, revile predecessors, abandon established explanations, and create their own confusion—the step Zhu opened.

sentences.zh: 韋彤，京兆人。

translations.literal: Wei Tong was a native of Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Tong was a native of Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 四世從祖方質為武後時宰相。

translations.literal: His fourth-generation collateral ancestor Fangzhi was chief minister in Empress Wu's time.
translations.idiomatic: His fourth-generation collateral ancestor Fangzhi was chief minister in Empress Wu's time.

sentences.zh: 彤名治《禮》，德宗時為太常博士。

translations.literal: Tong was famed for mastering the Rites; in Emperor Dezong's time he was Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Tong was famed for mastering the Rites; in Emperor Dezong's time he was Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 先此，天寶中，詔尚食朔望進食太廟，天子使中人侍祠，有司不與也。

translations.literal: Before this, in Tianbao an edict ordered the Imperial Kitchen on new and full moons to present food to the Grand Ancestral Temple; the Son of Heaven had eunuchs attend sacrifices—the relevant offices did not participate.
translations.idiomatic: Before this, in Tianbao an edict ordered the Imperial Kitchen on new and full moons to present food to the Grand Ancestral Temple; the Son of Heaven had eunuchs attend sacrifices—the relevant offices did not participate.

sentences.zh: 貞元十二年，帝始詔朔望食，畀宗正、太常合供。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Zhenyuan the emperor first ordered new and full moon offerings, assigning the Court of the Imperial Clan and Court of Imperial Sacrifices to supply jointly.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Zhenyuan the emperor first ordered new and full moon offerings, assigning the Court of the Imperial Clan and Court of Imperial Sacrifices to supply jointly.

sentences.zh: 於是彤與博士裴堪議曰：「禮，宗廟朔望不祭，園寢則有之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Tong together with Erudite Pei Kan debated: Ritual: ancestral temples do not sacrifice on new and full moons; garden tombs do.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Tong together with Erudite Pei Kan debated: "Ritual: ancestral temples do not sacrifice on new and full moons; garden tombs do.

sentences.zh: 貞觀、開元間，在禮若令，不敢變古。

translations.literal: In Zhenguan and Kaiyuan, in ritual and edict, they did not dare change antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenguan and Kaiyuan, in ritual and edict, they did not dare change antiquity.

sentences.zh: 天寶中，始有進食事，殆王玙緣生事亡，用燕具褻饌，參瀆禮薦，不可示遠。

translations.literal: In Tianbao the food presentation began—probably Wang Yu, seizing events of the time, used banquet vessels and intimate viands, mixing and profaning ritual offerings; this cannot be shown to distant ages.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianbao the food presentation began—probably Wang Yu, seizing events of the time, used banquet vessels and intimate viands, mixing and profaning ritual offerings; this cannot be shown to distant ages.

sentences.zh: 傳曰：『祭非外至，生於心者也。』

translations.literal: The tradition says: Sacrifice is not something arriving from outside—it is born in the heart.
translations.idiomatic: The tradition says: 'Sacrifice is not something arriving from outside—it is born in the heart.

sentences.zh: 是故聖人等牲牢，布籩豆，昆蟲、草木可薦者，莫不鹹在，所以享宗廟，交神明，全孝敬也。

translations.literal: Therefore the sage equalizes sacrificial beasts, sets out baskets and stands, and of insects, plants, and all that may be offered none is absent—thereby offering to the ancestral temple, joining with spirits, and completing filial reverence.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the sage equalizes sacrificial beasts, sets out baskets and stands, and of insects, plants, and all that may be offered none is absent—thereby offering to the ancestral temple, joining with spirits, and completing filial reverence.

sentences.zh: 潔膳羞，八珍百品，可嗜之饌，美膬甘旨，謂之褻味，所以燕賓客，接人情，示慈惠也。

translations.literal: Clean meals and delicacies, the eight treasures and hundred dishes, savory foods, fine meats and sweet flavors are called intimate flavors—thereby feasting guests, joining human feeling, and showing kindness and favor.
translations.idiomatic: Clean meals and delicacies, the eight treasures and hundred dishes, savory foods, fine meats and sweet flavors are called intimate flavors—thereby feasting guests, joining human feeling, and showing kindness and favor.

sentences.zh: 是則薦與宴，聖人判為二物，不可亂也。

translations.literal: Thus offering and banquet—the sage separates them as two things; they cannot be confused.
translations.idiomatic: Thus offering and banquet—the sage separates them as two things; they cannot be confused.

sentences.zh: 今若熟饔而享，非以異為敬之意。

translations.literal: If now cooked viands are offered in sacrifice, this is not the intent of taking the different as reverence.
translations.idiomatic: If now cooked viands are offered in sacrifice, this is not the intent of taking the different as reverence.

sentences.zh: 且祭不欲數，亦不欲疏，感時致享，以制中也。

translations.literal: Moreover sacrifice should not be frequent, nor should it be sparse; responding to the season and presenting offerings hits the middle.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover sacrifice should not be frequent, nor should it be sparse; responding to the season and presenting offerings hits the middle.

sentences.zh: 今園寢月二祭，不為疏，廟歲五享，不為數，有司奉承，得盡其恭。

translations.literal: Now garden tombs sacrifice twice monthly—not sparse; temples sacrifice five times yearly—not frequent; relevant offices in attendance can exhaust their reverence.
translations.idiomatic: Now garden tombs sacrifice twice monthly—not sparse; temples sacrifice five times yearly—not frequent; relevant offices in attendance can exhaust their reverence.

sentences.zh: 若又加盛饌於朔望，是失禮之中，有司不得盡其恭也。

translations.literal: If sumptuous viands are again added on new and full moons, this is excess within ritual's middle; relevant offices cannot exhaust their reverence.
translations.idiomatic: If sumptuous viands are again added on new and full moons, this is excess within ritual's middle; relevant offices cannot exhaust their reverence.

sentences.zh: 故王者稽古，弗敢以孝思之極而溢禮，弗敢以肴品之多而剩味。

translations.literal: Therefore the king examines antiquity and dares not exceed ritual through utmost filial thought, dares not surplus flavor through excessive dishes.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the king examines antiquity and dares not exceed ritual through utmost filial thought, dares not surplus flavor through excessive dishes.

sentences.zh: 願罷天寶所增，奉園寢以珍，奉宗廟以禮，兩得所宜。」

translations.literal: I wish to abolish what Tianbao added, offer garden tombs with delicacies, offer ancestral temples with ritual—both obtaining what is appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: I wish to abolish what Tianbao added, offer garden tombs with delicacies, offer ancestral temples with ritual—both obtaining what is appropriate."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「是禮先帝裁定，遽更之，其謂朕何？

translations.literal: The emperor said: This ritual was settled by the former emperor; to change it abruptly—what will people say of me?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "This ritual was settled by the former emperor; to change it abruptly—what will people say of me?

sentences.zh: 徐議其可。」

translations.literal: Slowly debate whether it can be done.
translations.idiomatic: Slowly debate whether it can be done."

sentences.zh: 而朔望食卒不廢。

translations.literal: Yet new and full moon offerings were ultimately not abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Yet new and full moon offerings were ultimately not abolished.

sentences.zh: 會昭陵寢宮為原火延燔，而客祭瑤臺佛寺。

translations.literal: When the Zhaoling garden tomb palace was extended and burned by prairie fire, guest sacrifices were offered at the Jade Terrace Buddhist temple.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zhaoling garden tomb palace was extended and burned by prairie fire, guest sacrifices were offered at the Jade Terrace Buddhist temple.

sentences.zh: 又故宮在山上，乏水泉，作者憚勞，欲即行宮作寢，詔宰相百官議。

translations.literal: Moreover the old palace was on the mountain, lacking water springs; workers feared the labor and wished to make the traveling palace the tomb palace; an edict ordered chief ministers and all officials to debate.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the old palace was on the mountain, lacking water springs; workers feared the labor and wished to make the traveling palace the tomb palace; an edict ordered chief ministers and all officials to debate.

sentences.zh: 吏部員外郎楊於陵議曰：「園寢非三代制，自秦、漢以來，附陵置寢，或遠若邇，則無聞焉。

translations.literal: Assistant Director of the Ministry of Personnel Yang Yuling debated: Garden tombs are not a Three Dynasties institution; from Qin and Han onward tombs had attached palaces, near or far without record.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Director of the Ministry of Personnel Yang Yuling debated: "Garden tombs are not a Three Dynasties institution; from Qin and Han onward tombs had attached palaces, near or far without record.

sentences.zh: 韋玄成等議園陵，於興廢初無適語。

translations.literal: Wei Xuancheng and others debated garden tombs with no definitive words on establishment or abolition at the beginning.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Xuancheng and others debated garden tombs with no definitive words on establishment or abolition at the beginning.

sentences.zh: 且寢宮所占，在柏城中，距陵不遠，使諸陵之寢，皆有區限，故不可徙；

translations.literal: Moreover the tomb palace occupies space within the cypress city, not far from the mound; if every tomb's palace had fixed limits it could not be moved.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the tomb palace occupies space within the cypress city, not far from the mound; if every tomb's palace had fixed limits it could not be moved.

sentences.zh: 若止柏城，則故寢已燔，行宮已久，因以治飾，亦復何嫌？

translations.literal: If limited to the cypress city, the old palace is already burned and the traveling palace long established—repairing it accordingly—what objection?
translations.idiomatic: If limited to the cypress city, the old palace is already burned and the traveling palace long established—repairing it accordingly—what objection?

sentences.zh: 或曰：『太宗創業，寢宮不輒易。』

translations.literal: Some say: Taizong founded the enterprise; the tomb palace should not be lightly changed.
translations.idiomatic: Some say: 'Taizong founded the enterprise; the tomb palace should not be lightly changed.

sentences.zh: 是不然。

translations.literal: This is not so.
translations.idiomatic: This is not so.

sentences.zh: 夫陵域宅神，神本靜，今大興荒廢，囂役密邇，非幽穸所安，改之便。」

translations.literal: The tomb domain houses the spirit; the spirit is originally still; now great works lie waste and noisy labor presses close—not where the dark chamber rests at ease; changing is convenient.
translations.idiomatic: The tomb domain houses the spirit; the spirit is originally still; now great works lie waste and noisy labor presses close—not where the dark chamber rests at ease; changing is convenient."

sentences.zh: 彤曰：「先王建都立邑，不利則為之遷，況有故邪？

translations.literal: Tong said: Former kings established capitals and cities; when unfavorable they moved—how much more when there is cause?
translations.idiomatic: Tong said: "Former kings established capitals and cities; when unfavorable they moved—how much more when there is cause?

sentences.zh: 今文寢災，徙而宮之，非無故也。

translations.literal: Now the text palace suffered fire; moving to make it the palace is not without cause.
translations.idiomatic: Now the text palace suffered fire; moving to make it the palace is not without cause.

sentences.zh: 神安於徙，因而建寢，於禮至順。

translations.literal: The spirit rests in the move; thereby building the palace—in ritual this is utmost compliance.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit rests in the move; thereby building the palace—in ritual this is utmost compliance.

sentences.zh: 又它陵皆在柏城，隨便營作，不越封兆，力省易從。」

translations.literal: Moreover other tombs are all in the cypress city; building conveniently without crossing the boundary mound saves labor and is easy to follow.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover other tombs are all in the cypress city; building conveniently without crossing the boundary mound saves labor and is easy to follow."

sentences.zh: 帝重改先帝制，還宮山顛。

translations.literal: The emperor valued changing the former emperor's institution and restored the palace on the mountain summit.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor valued changing the former emperor's institution and restored the palace on the mountain summit.

sentences.zh: 彤卒後，武宗會昌五年，詔京城不許群臣作私廟。

translations.literal: After Tong died, in the fifth year of Huizong's Huichang an edict forbade ministers in the capital from building private temples.
translations.idiomatic: After Tong died, in the fifth year of Huizong's Huichang an edict forbade ministers in the capital from building private temples.

sentences.zh: 宰相李德裕等引彤所議：「古制：廟必中門之外，吉兇皆告，以親而尊之，不自專也。

translations.literal: Chief Minister Li Deyu and others cited Tong's deliberation: Ancient institution: temples must be outside the middle gate; auspicious and inauspicious are all announced—to honor through kinship, not to act on one's own.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Minister Li Deyu and others cited Tong's deliberation: "Ancient institution: temples must be outside the middle gate; auspicious and inauspicious are all announced—to honor through kinship, not to act on one's own.

sentences.zh: 今俾立廟京外，不能得其意於禮。

translations.literal: Now establishing temples outside the capital cannot obtain ritual's intent.
translations.idiomatic: Now establishing temples outside the capital cannot obtain ritual's intent.

sentences.zh: 宮之南九坊，三坊曰圍外，地荒左，立廟無嫌；

translations.literal: South of the palace nine wards—three wards called outside the enclosure, land barren on the left, establishing temples without objection.
translations.idiomatic: South of the palace nine wards—three wards called outside the enclosure, land barren on the left, establishing temples without objection;

sentences.zh: 余六坊可禁。」

translations.literal: the remaining six wards may be forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: the remaining six wards may be forbidden."

sentences.zh: 詔不許，聽準古即居所立廟。

translations.literal: An edict did not permit it; they were allowed to establish temples at their residences according to antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: An edict did not permit it; they were allowed to establish temples at their residences according to antiquity.

sentences.zh: 陳京，字慶復，陳宜都王叔明五世孫。

translations.literal: Chen Jing, courtesy name Qingfu, was fifth-generation descendant of Chen Prince of Yidu Shuming.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Jing, courtesy name Qingfu, was fifth-generation descendant of Chen Prince of Yidu Shuming.

sentences.zh: 父兼，為右補闕、翰林學士。

translations.literal: His father Jian served as Right Supplementation Censor and Hanlin Scholar.
translations.idiomatic: His father Jian served as Right Supplementation Censor and Hanlin Scholar.

sentences.zh: 京善文辭，常袞稱之，妻以兄子。

translations.literal: Jing was skilled in literary composition; Chang Gun praised him and gave him his elder brother's son in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: Jing was skilled in literary composition; Chang Gun praised him and gave him his elder brother's son in marriage.

sentences.zh: 擢進士第，遷累太常博士。

translations.literal: Selected in the jinshi examination, he was transferred in succession to Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Selected in the jinshi examination, he was transferred in succession to Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 德宗在奉天，聞段秀實為賊所害，七日不朝。

translations.literal: When Dezong was at Fengtian he heard Duan Xiushi was killed by rebels and for seven days did not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: When Dezong was at Fengtian he heard Duan Xiushi was killed by rebels and for seven days did not hold court.

sentences.zh: 宰相以為「方多難時，不宜壅萬機，天下其謂何？」

translations.literal: The chief minister said: In a time of many difficulties it is inappropriate to block myriad affairs—what will the realm say?
translations.idiomatic: The chief minister said: "In a time of many difficulties it is inappropriate to block myriad affairs—what will the realm say?"

sentences.zh: 京曰：「丞相之言非也。

translations.literal: Jing said: The chief minister's words are wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Jing said: "The chief minister's words are wrong.

sentences.zh: 夫褒大節，恤賢臣，天下所以安，況卓卓特異者乎？」

translations.literal: To honor great integrity and show care for worthy ministers is how the realm is secured—how much more for those outstanding and singular?
translations.idiomatic: To honor great integrity and show care for worthy ministers is how the realm is secured—how much more for those outstanding and singular?"

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「善。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: Good.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Good."

sentences.zh: 還京師，擢左補闕。

translations.literal: Returning to the capital he was promoted to Left Supplementation Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the capital he was promoted to Left Supplementation Censor.

sentences.zh: 帝以盧杞為饒州刺史，京與趙需、裴佶、宇文炫、盧景亮、張薦共劾：「杞輔政要位，大臣逾時月不得對，百官懍懍常若兵在頸。

translations.literal: When the emperor appointed Lu Qi Prefect of Raozhou, Jing together with Zhao Xu, Pei Ji, Yuwen Xuan, Lu Jingliang, and Zhang Jian jointly impeached: Qi as chief minister held key position; great ministers for more than a month could not gain audience; all officials trembled as if blades were at their necks.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor appointed Lu Qi Prefect of Raozhou, Jing together with Zhao Xu, Pei Ji, Yuwen Xuan, Lu Jingliang, and Zhang Jian jointly impeached: "Qi as chief minister held key position; great ministers for more than a month could not gain audience; all officials trembled as if blades were at their necks.

sentences.zh: 陛下復用之，奸賊唾掌復興。」

translations.literal: Your Majesty reappoints him—traitors and villains will clap hands and rise again.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty reappoints him—traitors and villains will clap hands and rise again."

sentences.zh: 帝不聽。

translations.literal: The emperor would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor would not listen.

sentences.zh: 京等爭尤確，帝大怒，左右辟易，諫者稍引卻。

translations.literal: Jing and the others argued especially firmly; the emperor was greatly angered; attendants shrank back and remonstrators gradually withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Jing and the others argued especially firmly; the emperor was greatly angered; attendants shrank back and remonstrators gradually withdrew.

sentences.zh: 京正色曰：「需等毋遽退！」

translations.literal: Jing with stern countenance said: Xu and the others do not hastily retreat!
translations.idiomatic: Jing with stern countenance said: "Xu and the others do not hastely retreat!"

sentences.zh: 極道不可，以死請，杞遂廢。

translations.literal: He exhaustively argued it could not be done and pleaded with his life; Qi was thereby dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: He exhaustively argued it could not be done and pleaded with his life; Qi was thereby dismissed.

sentences.zh: 帝之立，迎訪太后，久不得，意且怠。

translations.literal: When the emperor was established he sought and welcomed the Empress Dowager; long unable to find her his intent grew slack.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor was established he sought and welcomed the Empress Dowager; long unable to find her his intent grew slack.

sentences.zh: 京密白：「第遣使物色以求。」

translations.literal: Jing secretly reported: Just send envoys to search by description and seek.
translations.idiomatic: Jing secretly reported: "Just send envoys to search by description and seek."

sentences.zh: 帝大悟，終代不敢置。

translations.literal: The emperor greatly understood and thereafter dared not neglect the matter.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor greatly understood and thereafter dared not neglect the matter.

sentences.zh: 初，玄宗、肅宗既祔室，遷獻、懿二祖於西夾室，引太祖位東向。

translations.literal: Initially after Xuanzong and Suzong were enshrined, Xian and Yi were moved to the west side chambers and the Grand Ancestor was placed facing east.
translations.idiomatic: Initially after Xuanzong and Suzong were enshrined, Xian and Yi were moved to the west side chambers and the Grand Ancestor was placed facing east.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使於休烈議：「獻、懿屬尊於太祖，若合食，則太祖位不得正，請藏二祖神主，以太宗、中宗、睿宗、肅宗從世祖南向，高宗、玄宗從高祖北向。」

translations.literal: Ritual Commissioner Yu Xiulie debated: Xian and Yi are more exalted than the Grand Ancestor; if jointly offered, the Grand Ancestor's position cannot be correct. I request storing the spirit tablets of the two ancestors and having Taizong, Zhongzong, Ruizong, and Suzong follow Shizu facing south, and Gaozong and Xuanzong follow Gaozu facing north.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual Commissioner Yu Xiulie debated: "Xian and Yi are more exalted than the Grand Ancestor; if jointly offered, the Grand Ancestor's position cannot be correct. sentences.zh: 禘祫不及二祖，凡十八年。

translations.literal: Di and he sacrifices did not include the two ancestors—for eighteen years in all.
translations.idiomatic: Di and he sacrifices did not include the two ancestors—for eighteen years in all.

sentences.zh: 建中初，代宗喪畢，當大祫。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianzhong, when Emperor Daizong's mourning ended, the great he sacrifice was due.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jianzhong, when Emperor Daizong's mourning ended, the great he sacrifice was due.

sentences.zh: 京以太常博士上言：「《春秋》之義，毀廟之主陳於太祖，未毀廟之主合食於祖，無毀廟遷主不享之言。

translations.literal: Jing as Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices submitted: The meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals: tablets of destroyed temples are displayed before the Grand Ancestor; tablets of undestroyed temples are jointly offered to the ancestor; there is no statement about moving tablets of undestroyed temples not being offered.
translations.idiomatic: Jing as Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices submitted: "The meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals: tablets of destroyed temples are displayed before the Grand Ancestor; tablets of undestroyed temples are jointly offered to the ancestor; there is no statement about moving tablets of undestroyed temples not being offered.

sentences.zh: 唐家祀制與周異，周以後稷為始封祖，而毀主皆在後稷下，故太祖東向，常統其尊。

translations.literal: Tang sacrificial institutions differ from Zhou; Zhou took Hou Ji as the founding ancestor and all destroyed tablets were below Hou Ji; therefore the Grand Ancestor faced east and always commanded honor.
translations.idiomatic: Tang sacrificial institutions differ from Zhou; Zhou took Hou Ji as the founding ancestor and all destroyed tablets were below Hou Ji; therefore the Grand Ancestor faced east and always commanded honor.

sentences.zh: 司馬晉以高皇、太皇、征西四府君為別廟，大禘祫則正太祖位，無所屈。

translations.literal: Jin took the High Emperor, Grand Emperor, and Western Expedition Four Lords as separate temples; at great di and he the Grand Ancestor's position was corrected with no bending.
translations.idiomatic: Jin took the High Emperor, Grand Emperor, and Western Expedition Four Lords as separate temples; at great di and he the Grand Ancestor's position was corrected with no bending.

sentences.zh: 別廟祭高、太以降，所以敘親也。

translations.literal: Separate temples sacrificing from the High and Grand Emperors downward order kinship.
translations.idiomatic: Separate temples sacrificing from the High and Grand Emperors downward order kinship.

sentences.zh: 唐家宜別為獻、懿二祖立廟，禘祫則祭，太祖遂正東向位。

translations.literal: Tang should separately establish temples for Xian and Yi; at di and he sacrifice; the Grand Ancestor then correctly faces east.
translations.idiomatic: Tang should separately establish temples for Xian and Yi; at di and he sacrifice; the Grand Ancestor then correctly faces east.

sentences.zh: 德明、興聖二帝，向已有廟，則藏祔二祖為宜。」

translations.literal: Deming and Xingsheng already had temples; storing and enshrining the two ancestors is appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Deming and Xingsheng already had temples; storing and enshrining the two ancestors is appropriate."

sentences.zh: 詔百官普議。

translations.literal: An edict ordered all officials to debate broadly.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered all officials to debate broadly.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使、太子少師顏真卿曰：「今議者有三：一謂獻、懿親遠而遷，不當祫，宜藏主西室；

translations.literal: Ritual Commissioner and Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent Yan Zhenqing said: Today's debaters have three views: first, Xian and Yi are distant in kinship and moved— they should not be he-offered and their tablets should be stored in the west chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual Commissioner and Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent Yan Zhenqing said: "Today's debaters have three views: first, Xian and Yi are distant in kinship and moved—they should not be he-offered and their tablets should be stored in the west chamber;

sentences.zh: 二謂二祖宜祫食，與太祖並昭穆，闕東向位；

translations.literal: second, the two ancestors should be he-offered with the Grand Ancestor in zhao-mu order, leaving the east-facing position vacant.
translations.idiomatic: second, the two ancestors should be he-offered with the Grand Ancestor in zhao-mu order, leaving the east-facing position vacant;

sentences.zh: 三謂引二祖祫禘，即太祖永不得全其始，宜以二主祔德明廟。

translations.literal: third, bringing the two ancestors into di and he means the Grand Ancestor can never fully hold his beginning; the two lords should be enshrined in the Deming Temple.
translations.idiomatic: third, bringing the two ancestors into di and he means the Grand Ancestor can never fully hold his beginning; the two lords should be enshrined in the Deming Temple.

sentences.zh: 雖然，於人神未厭也。

translations.literal: Even so, human and divine are not yet satisfied.
translations.idiomatic: Even so, human and divine are not yet satisfied.

sentences.zh: 景帝既受命始封矣，百代不遷矣，而又配天，尊無與上，至禘祫時，蹔屈昭穆以申孝尊先，實明神之意，所以教天下之孝也。

translations.literal: Jingdi once received the mandate and was first enfeoffed—never moved for a hundred generations—and moreover was paired with Heaven, honor none above; at di and he time temporarily bending zhao-mu to express filial reverence for ancestors is truly the bright spirits' intent and teaches filial piety to all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Jingdi once received the mandate and was first enfeoffed—never moved for a hundred generations—and moreover was paired with Heaven, honor none above; at di and he time temporarily bending zhao-mu to express filial reverence for ancestors is truly the bright spirits' intent and teaches filial piety to all under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 況晉蔡謨等有成議，不為無據。

translations.literal: Moreover Jin's Cai Mo and others had established deliberation—not without basis.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Jin's Cai Mo and others had established deliberation—not without basis.

sentences.zh: 請大祫享奉獻主東向，懿主居昭，景主居穆，重本尚順，為萬代法。

translations.literal: I request at the great he sacrifice offering the Xian tablet facing east, the Yi tablet in zhao, the Jing tablet in mu—honoring the root and esteeming compliance, as law for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: I request at the great he sacrifice offering the Xian tablet facing east, the Yi tablet in zhao, the Jing tablet in mu—honoring the root and esteeming compliance, as law for ten thousand generations.

sentences.zh: 夫祫，合也。

translations.idiomatic: He means joining.

translations.idiomatic: If separately offering to Deming, this is divided offering—not joint offering."

sentences.zh: 時議者舉然。

translations.literal: At the time debaters agreed in uproar.
translations.idiomatic: At the time debaters agreed in uproar.

sentences.zh: 於是還獻、懿主祫於廟，如真卿議。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Xian and Yi tablets were returned to he-offering in the temple as Yan Zhenqing proposed.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Xian and Yi tablets were returned to he-offering in the temple as Yan Zhenqing proposed.

sentences.zh: 貞元七年，太常卿裴郁上言：「商、周以卨、稷為祖，上無余尊，故合食有序。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhenyuan Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Pei Yu submitted: Shang and Zhou took Qi and Ji as ancestors; above there was no surplus exaltation; therefore joint offering had order.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Zhenyuan Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Pei Yu submitted: "Shang and Zhou took Qi and Ji as ancestors; above there was no surplus exaltation; therefore joint offering had order.

sentences.zh: 漢受命，祖高皇帝，故太上皇不以昭穆合食。

translations.literal: Han received the mandate and took Emperor Gao as ancestor; therefore the Grand Emperor Supreme was not jointly offered in zhao-mu.
translations.idiomatic: Han received the mandate and took Emperor Gao as ancestor; therefore the Grand Emperor Supreme was not jointly offered in zhao-mu.

sentences.zh: 魏祖武帝，晉祖宣帝，故高皇、處士、征西等君，亦不以昭穆合食。

translations.literal: Wei took Emperor Wu as ancestor; Jin took Emperor Xuan as ancestor; therefore the High Emperor, Recluse, Western Expedition and others were also not jointly offered in zhao-mu.
translations.idiomatic: Wei took Emperor Wu as ancestor; Jin took Emperor Xuan as ancestor; therefore the High Emperor, Recluse, Western Expedition and others were also not jointly offered in zhao-mu.

sentences.zh: 景皇帝始封唐，唐推祖焉，而獻、懿親盡廟遷，猶居東向，非禮之祀，神所不享。

translations.literal: Jingdi was first enfeoffed with Tang; Tang traced its ancestor thereby; yet Xian and Yi with exhausted kinship and moved temples still occupied the east-facing position—sacrifice not of ritual—the spirits do not accept.
translations.idiomatic: Jingdi was first enfeoffed with Tang; Tang traced its ancestor thereby; yet Xian and Yi with exhausted kinship and moved temples still occupied the east-facing position—sacrifice not of ritual—the spirits do not accept.

translations.literal: I wish the ministers below to debate.
translations.idiomatic: I wish the ministers below to debate."

translations.literal: Thereupon Left Subordinate to the Heir Apparent Li Rong and others submitted: Respectfully according to Jin Sun Qin's deliberation: Before the Grand Ancestor, though there were lords, di and he did not reach them.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Left Subordinate to the Heir Apparent Li Rong and others submitted: "Respectfully according to Jin Sun Qin's deliberation: 'Before the Grand Ancestor, though there were lords, di and he did not reach them;

sentences.zh: 其所及者，太祖後未毀已升藏於二祧者，故雖百代及之。』

translations.literal: Those reached were after the Grand Ancestor, undestroyed and already elevated and stored in the two tiao—therefore though a hundred generations they were reached.
translations.idiomatic: those reached were after the Grand Ancestor, undestroyed and already elevated and stored in the two tiao—therefore though a hundred generations they were reached.

sentences.zh: 獻、懿在始封前，親盡主遷，上擬三代，則禘祫所不及。

translations.literal: Xian and Yi were before the first enfeoffment; kinship exhausted, lords moved; comparing upward to the Three Dynasties, di and he did not reach them.
translations.idiomatic: Xian and Yi were before the first enfeoffment; kinship exhausted, lords moved; comparing upward to the Three Dynasties, di and he did not reach them.

sentences.zh: 太祖而下，若世祖，則《春秋》所謂『陳於太祖』者。

translations.literal: Below the Grand Ancestor, like Shizu, are what the Spring and Autumn Annals calls displayed before the Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Below the Grand Ancestor, like Shizu, are what the Spring and Autumn Annals calls 'displayed before the Grand Ancestor.'

sentences.zh: 漢議罷郡國廟，丞相韋玄成議：『太上皇、孝惠親盡宜毀。

translations.literal: Han debated abolishing commandery and kingdom temples; Chancellor Wei Xuancheng deliberated: The Grand Emperor Supreme and Emperor Xiaohui with exhausted kinship should be destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Han debated abolishing commandery and kingdom temples; Chancellor Wei Xuancheng deliberated: 'The Grand Emperor Supreme and Emperor Xiaohui with exhausted kinship should be destroyed.

sentences.zh: 太上主宜瘞於園，惠主遷高廟。』

translations.literal: The Grand Emperor Supreme's tablet should be buried in the garden; Emperor Xiaohui's tablet moved to the High Temple.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Emperor Supreme's tablet should be buried in the garden; Emperor Xiaohui's tablet moved to the High Temple.

sentences.zh: 太上皇在太祖前，主瘞於園，不及禘祫，獻、懿比也。

translations.literal: The Grand Emperor Supreme was before the Grand Ancestor; tablet buried in garden, not reaching di and he—comparable to Xian and Yi.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Emperor Supreme was before the Grand Ancestor; tablet buried in garden, not reaching di and he—comparable to Xian and Yi.

sentences.zh: 惠遷高廟，在太祖後，而及禘祫，世祖比也。

translations.literal: Xiaohui moved to High Temple after the Grand Ancestor and reached di and he—comparable to Shizu.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaohui moved to High Temple after the Grand Ancestor and reached di and he—comparable to Shizu.

sentences.zh: 魏明帝遷處士主置園邑，歲時以令丞奉薦；

translations.literal: Wei Emperor Ming moved the Recluse's tablet and established a garden settlement; seasonally the magistrate and assistant presented offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Emperor Ming moved the Recluse's tablet and established a garden settlement; seasonally the magistrate and assistant presented offerings;

sentences.zh: 東晉以征西等祖遷入西除，同謂之祧，皆不及祀。

translations.literal: Eastern Jin moved Western Expedition and other ancestors into the west wing, together called tiao—all not reaching sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Jin moved Western Expedition and other ancestors into the west wing, together called tiao—all not reaching sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 故唐初下訖開元，禘祫猶虛東向位。

translations.literal: Therefore from early Tang through Kaiyuan, di and he still left the east-facing position vacant.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore from early Tang through Kaiyuan, di and he still left the east-facing position vacant.

sentences.zh: 洎立九廟，追祖獻、懿，然祝於三祖不稱臣。

translations.literal: When nine temples were established and Xian and Yi were traced as ancestors, yet in invoking the three ancestors they were not called subjects.
translations.idiomatic: When nine temples were established and Xian and Yi were traced as ancestors, yet in invoking the three ancestors they were not called subjects.

sentences.zh: 至德時，復作廟，遂不為弘農府君主，以祀不及也。

translations.literal: In the Zhide era temples were rebuilt again; therefore they were not made lords of Hongnong Prefecture—sacrifice did not reach them.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhide era temples were rebuilt again; therefore they were not made lords of Hongnong Prefecture—sacrifice did not reach them.

sentences.zh: 廣德中，始以景皇帝當東向位，以獻、懿兩主親盡，罷祫而藏。

translations.literal: In the Guangde era Jingdi was first placed in the east-facing position; Xian and Yi with exhausted kinship ceased he-offering and were stored.
translations.idiomatic: In the Guangde era Jingdi was first placed in the east-facing position; Xian and Yi with exhausted kinship ceased he-offering and were stored.

sentences.zh: 顏真卿引蔡謨議，復奉獻主東向，懿昭景穆。

translations.literal: Yan Zhenqing cited Cai Mo's deliberation and again placed the Xian tablet facing east, Yi in zhao, Jing in mu.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Zhenqing cited Cai Mo's deliberation and again placed the Xian tablet facing east, Yi in zhao, Jing in mu.

sentences.zh: 不記謨議晉未嘗用，而唐一王法容可準乎？

translations.literal: He did not note that Mo's deliberation was never used in Jin—can Tang's single royal law be taken as standard?
translations.idiomatic: He did not note that Mo's deliberation was never used in Jin—can Tang's single royal law be taken as standard?

sentences.zh: 臣等謂嘗、禘、郊、社無二尊，瘞、毀、遷、藏，各以義斷。

translations.literal: We hold that seasonal, di, suburban, and altar sacrifices have no two exalted ones; burial, destruction, moving, and storing each follow meaning.
translations.idiomatic: We hold that seasonal, di, suburban, and altar sacrifices have no two exalted ones; burial, destruction, moving, and storing each follow meaning.

sentences.zh: 景皇帝已東向，一日改易，不可謂禮，宜復藏獻、懿二主於西室，以本《祭法》『遠廟為祧，去祧而壇，去壇而墠，壇、墠，有禱祭，無禱止』之義。

translations.literal: Jingdi already faces east—to change in one day cannot be called ritual; it is appropriate to again store Xian and Yi in the west chamber, following the Canon of Sacrifices: distant temples are tiao; leaving tiao is altar; leaving altar is open ground; altar and open ground have prayer sacrifices, without prayer stop.

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestor obtains correctness with no bending.

translations.literal: Director of the Ministry of Works Liu Mian and twelve others debated: The Son of Heaven takes the mandate-receiving lord as Grand Ancestor; feudal lords take the first-enfeoffed lord as ancestor; therefore below Grand Ancestor and ancestor kinship is exhausted and temples destroyed in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Ministry of Works Liu Mian and twelve others debated: "The Son of Heaven takes the mandate-receiving lord as Grand Ancestor; feudal lords take the first-enfeoffed lord as ancestor; therefore below Grand Ancestor and ancestor kinship is exhausted and temples destroyed in succession.

translations.literal: When Qin extinguished learning Han had no leisure for ritual; Jin lost and Song followed—hence the institution of linked royal temples and the vacant Grand Ancestor position.
translations.idiomatic: When Qin extinguished learning Han had no leisure for ritual; Jin lost and Song followed—hence the institution of linked royal temples and the vacant Grand Ancestor position.

sentences.zh: 且不列昭穆，非所謂有序；

translations.literal: Moreover not arranging zhao-mu is not what is called ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover not arranging zhao-mu is not what is called ordered;

sentences.zh: 不建叠毀，非所謂有殺；

translations.literal: not establishing successive destruction is not what is called gradation.
translations.idiomatic: not establishing successive destruction is not what is called gradation;

sentences.zh: 連王廟，非所謂有別；

translations.literal: linked royal temples is not what is called distinction.
translations.idiomatic: linked royal temples is not what is called distinction;

translations.idiomatic: vacant Grand Ancestor position is not what is called single exaltation.

translations.idiomatic: This is why ritual was abandoned.

translations.literal: The tradition says: The father was a servitor, the son is Son of Heaven—sacrifice with Son of Heaven ritual, bury with servitor ritual.
translations.idiomatic: The tradition says: 'The father was a servitor, the son is Son of Heaven—sacrifice with Son of Heaven ritual, bury with servitor ritual.

sentences.zh: 今獻、懿二祖，在唐未受命時，猶士也。

translations.literal: Now Xian and Yi before Tang received the mandate were still servitors.
translations.idiomatic: Now Xian and Yi before Tang received the mandate were still servitors.

sentences.zh: 故高祖、太宗以天子之禮祭之，而不敢奉以東向位。

translations.literal: Therefore Gaozu and Taizong sacrificed to them with Son of Heaven ritual but dared not place them in the east-facing position.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore Gaozu and Taizong sacrificed to them with Son of Heaven ritual but dared not place them in the east-facing position.

sentences.zh: 今而易之，無乃亂先帝序乎？

translations.literal: To change now—would this not disorder the former emperor's sequence?
translations.idiomatic: To change now—would this not disorder the former emperor's sequence?

sentences.zh: 周有天下，追王太王、王季以天子禮；

translations.literal: When Zhou possessed the realm it posthumously ennobled Grand King and King Ji with Son of Heaven ritual.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhou possessed the realm it posthumously ennobled Grand King and King Ji with Son of Heaven ritual;

translations.idiomatic: at their sacrifice kinship was exhausted and temples destroyed.

translations.literal: When Han possessed the realm it honored the Grand Emperor Supreme with Son of Heaven ritual.
translations.idiomatic: When Han possessed the realm it honored the Grand Emperor Supreme with Son of Heaven ritual;

translations.literal: At sacrifice kinship was exhausted and temples destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: at sacrifice kinship was exhausted and temples destroyed.

translations.literal: Tang posthumously ennobled Xian and Yi with Son of Heaven ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Tang posthumously ennobled Xian and Yi with Son of Heaven ritual;

sentences.zh: 及其祭也，親盡而毀，復何所疑？

translations.literal: At their sacrifice kinship is exhausted and temples destroyed—what further doubt?
translations.idiomatic: at their sacrifice kinship is exhausted and temples destroyed—what further doubt?

translations.literal: The Offices of Zhou has tiao of former dukes and tiao of former kings.
translations.idiomatic: The Offices of Zhou has tiao of former dukes and tiao of former kings.

translations.idiomatic: Former dukes' moved tablets stored in Hou Ji's temple—is this Zhou before receiving the mandate's tiao?

translations.literal: Former kings' moved tablets stored in Wen and Wu's temple—is this Zhou after receiving the mandate's tiao?
translations.idiomatic: Former kings' moved tablets stored in Wen and Wu's temple—is this Zhou after receiving the mandate's tiao?

translations.literal: Therefore there are two tiao—this is why temples differ.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore there are two tiao—this is why temples differ.

translations.literal: Director of Works Zhang Jian and others requested from Xian downward all enter zhao-mu, leaving the east-facing position vacant.
translations.idiomatic: Director of Works Zhang Jian and others requested from Xian downward all enter zhao-mu, leaving the east-facing position vacant.

sentences.zh: 司勛員外郎裴樞曰：「《禮》：『親親故尊祖，尊祖故敬宗，敬宗故收族，收族故宗廟嚴，宗廟嚴故社稷重。』

translations.literal: Director of Merit Pei Shu said: The Rites: Through cherishing kin one honors ancestors; through honoring ancestors one reveres the lineage; through revering the lineage one gathers the clan; through gathering the clan ancestral temples are stern; through stern ancestral temples the altars of soil and grain are weighty.
translations.idiomatic: Director of Merit Pei Shu said: "The Rites: 'Through cherishing kin one honors ancestors; through honoring ancestors one reveres the lineage; through revering the lineage one gathers the clan; through gathering the clan ancestral temples are stern; through stern ancestral temples the altars of soil and grain are weighty.

sentences.zh: 太祖之上，復追尊焉，則尊祖之義乖。

translations.literal: Above the Grand Ancestor further posthumous honor—then the meaning of honoring ancestors is wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Above the Grand Ancestor further posthumous honor—then the meaning of honoring ancestors is wrong.

sentences.zh: 太廟之外，別祭廟焉，則社稷不重。

translations.literal: Outside the Grand Temple separate sacrifice temples—then the altars of soil and grain are not weighty.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the Grand Temple separate sacrifice temples—then the altars of soil and grain are not weighty.

sentences.zh: 漢韋玄成請瘞主於園，晉虞喜請瘞廟兩階間。

translations.literal: Han's Wei Xuancheng requested burying tablets in the garden; Jin's Yu Xi requested burying between the temple's two flights.
translations.idiomatic: Han's Wei Xuancheng requested burying tablets in the garden; Jin's Yu Xi requested burying between the temple's two flights.

sentences.zh: 喜據左氏自證曰：『先王日祭祖、考，月祀曾、高，時享及二祧，歲祫及壇墠，終禘及郊宗石室，是謂郊宗之祖。』

translations.literal: Xi citing the Zuo Tradition self-justified: Former kings daily sacrificed to ancestors and fathers, monthly to great-great and great-grandfathers, seasonal offering reaching two tiao, yearly he reaching altar and open ground, final di reaching suburban ancestral stone chamber—this is called suburban ancestral ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Xi citing the Zuo Tradition self-justified: 'Former kings daily sacrificed to ancestors and fathers, monthly to great-great and great-grandfathers, seasonal offering reaching two tiao, yearly he reaching altar and open ground, final di reaching suburban ancestral stone chamber—this is called suburban ancestral ancestor.

sentences.zh: 喜請夾室中為石室以處之，是不然。

translations.literal: Xi requested building a stone chamber in the side room to house them—this is not so.
translations.idiomatic: Xi requested building a stone chamber in the side room to house them—this is not so.

sentences.zh: 何者？

translations.literal: Why?
translations.idiomatic: Why?

sentences.zh: 夾室所以居太祖下，非太祖上藏主所居。

translations.literal: Side rooms are for below the Grand Ancestor—not where tablets are stored above the Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Side rooms are for below the Grand Ancestor—not where tablets are stored above the Grand Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 未有卑處正、尊居傍也。

translations.literal: Never has the low occupied the center while the exalted dwelt at the side.
translations.idiomatic: Never has the low occupied the center while the exalted dwelt at the side.

sentences.zh: 若建石室於園寢，安遷主，采漢、晉舊章，祫禘率一祭，庶乎《春秋》得變之正。」

translations.literal: If building a stone chamber in the garden tomb and placing moved tablets, adopting Han and Jin old statutes, di and he following one sacrifice—perhaps the Spring and Autumn Annals obtains the correct of change.
translations.idiomatic: If building a stone chamber in the garden tomb and placing moved tablets, adopting Han and Jin old statutes, di and he following one sacrifice—perhaps the Spring and Autumn Annals obtains the correct of change."

sentences.zh: 是時，京以考功員外郎又言：「興聖皇帝則獻之曾祖，懿之高祖。

translations.literal: At that time Jing as Assistant Director of the Ministry of Personnel again said: Emperor Xingsheng was Xian's great-great-grandfather, Yi's great-grandfather.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Jing as Assistant Director of the Ministry of Personnel again said: "Emperor Xingsheng was Xian's great-great-grandfather, Yi's great-grandfather.

sentences.zh: 以曾孫祔曾高之廟，人情大順也。」

translations.literal: To enshrine great-great-grandson in great-great and great-grandfather's temple—human feeling greatly compliant.
translations.idiomatic: To enshrine great-great-grandson in great-great and great-grandfather's temple—human feeling greatly compliant."

sentences.zh: 京兆少尹韋武曰：「祫則大合，禘則序祧。

translations.literal: Assistant Governor of the Capital Wei Wu said: He is great joining; di orders tiao.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Governor of the Capital Wei Wu said: "He is great joining; di orders tiao.

sentences.zh: 當祫之歲，常以獻東向，率懿而後以昭穆極親親。

translations.literal: In he years regularly place Xian facing east, leading Yi afterward with zhao-mu utmost kinship.
translations.idiomatic: In he years regularly place Xian facing east, leading Yi afterward with zhao-mu utmost kinship.

sentences.zh: 及禘，則太祖筵於西，列眾主左右，是於太祖不為降，獻無所厭。」

translations.literal: At di the Grand Ancestor's mat is west, arraying all lords left and right—thus toward the Grand Ancestor there is no lowering; Xian has nothing to resent.
translations.idiomatic: At di the Grand Ancestor's mat is west, arraying all lords left and right—thus toward the Grand Ancestor there is no lowering; Xian has nothing to resent."

sentences.zh: 時諸儒以左氏「子齊聖，不先父食」，請迎獻主權東向，太祖暫還穆位。

translations.literal: At the time Confucians citing the Zuo Tradition that the son was sage and did not eat before the father requested welcoming the Xian tablet provisionally facing east while the Grand Ancestor temporarily returned to mu position.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Confucians citing the Zuo Tradition that 'the son was sage and did not eat before the father' requested welcoming the Xian tablet provisionally facing east while the Grand Ancestor temporarily returned to mu position.

sentences.zh: 同官尉仲子陵曰：「所謂不先食者，丘明正文公逆祀。

translations.literal: Colleague Erudite Zhong Ziling said: What is called not eating first—Qiuming was correcting Duke Wen's improper sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Colleague Erudite Zhong Ziling said: "What is called not eating first—Qiuming was correcting Duke Wen's improper sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 儒者安知夏後世數未足時，言禹不先鯀乎？

translations.literal: How would Confucians know that when Xia's generations were not yet sufficient it was said Yu did not place Gun first?
translations.idiomatic: How would Confucians know that when Xia's generations were not yet sufficient it was said Yu did not place Gun first?

sentences.zh: 魏、晉始祖率近，始祖上皆有遷主。

translations.literal: Wei and Jin founding ancestors were close in succession; above the founding ancestor all had moved lords.
translations.idiomatic: Wei and Jin founding ancestors were close in succession; above the founding ancestor all had moved lords.

sentences.zh: 引《宮》詩，則永可也。

translations.literal: Citing the Gong Ode, perpetual offering is possible.
translations.idiomatic: Citing the Gong Ode, perpetual offering is possible;

sentences.zh: 因虞主，則瘞園可也。

translations.literal: following the plain tablet, burial in garden is possible.
translations.idiomatic: following the plain tablet, burial in garden is possible;

sentences.zh: 緣遠祧，則築宮可也。

translations.literal: following distant tiao, building a shrine is possible.
translations.idiomatic: following distant tiao, building a shrine is possible;

sentences.zh: 以太祖實卑，則虛位可也。

translations.literal: because the Grand Ancestor is truly lower, vacant position is possible.
translations.idiomatic: because the Grand Ancestor is truly lower, vacant position is possible.

sentences.zh: 然永與瘞園，臣子所不安。

translations.literal: Yet perpetual offering and garden burial—ministers and sons cannot be at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Yet perpetual offering and garden burial—ministers and sons cannot be at ease.

sentences.zh: 若虛正位，則太祖之尊無時而申。

translations.literal: If vacating the correct position, the Grand Ancestor's honor has no time to be expressed.
translations.idiomatic: If vacating the correct position, the Grand Ancestor's honor has no time to be expressed.

sentences.zh: 請奉獻、懿二祖遷於德明、興聖廟為順。

translations.literal: I request moving Xian and Yi to the Deming and Xingsheng temples as compliant.
translations.idiomatic: I request moving Xian and Yi to the Deming and Xingsheng temples as compliant.

sentences.zh: 或曰二祖別廟，非合食。

translations.literal: Some say separate temples for the two ancestors is not joint offering.
translations.idiomatic: Some say separate temples for the two ancestors is not joint offering.

sentences.zh: 且德明、興聖二廟禘祫之年，皆有薦饗，是已分食，奚獨疑二祖乎？」

translations.literal: Yet in di and he years the Deming and Xingsheng temples all have offerings—is this already divided offering; why doubt only the two ancestors?
translations.idiomatic: Yet in di and he years the Deming and Xingsheng temples all have offerings—is this already divided offering; why doubt only the two ancestors?"

sentences.zh: 國子四門博士韓愈質眾議，自申其說曰：「一謂獻、懿二主宜永藏夾室，臣不謂可。

translations.literal: National University Simen Erudite Han Yu questioned the crowd's deliberation and stated his own view: First, the Xian and Yi tablets should be permanently stored in side chambers—I do not say this is acceptable.
translations.idiomatic: National University Simen Erudite Han Yu questioned the crowd's deliberation and stated his own view: "First, the Xian and Yi tablets should be permanently stored in side chambers—I do not say this is acceptable.

sentences.zh: 且禮，祫祭，毀主皆合食。

translations.literal: Moreover in ritual he sacrifice—all destroyed lords are jointly offered.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover in ritual he sacrifice—all destroyed lords are jointly offered.

sentences.zh: 今藏夾室，至祫得不食太廟乎？

translations.literal: Now storing in side chambers—at he will they not be offered in the Grand Temple?
translations.idiomatic: Now storing in side chambers—at he will they not be offered in the Grand Temple?

sentences.zh: 若二祖不豫，不謂之合矣。

translations.literal: If the two ancestors are not included, it cannot be called joining.
translations.idiomatic: If the two ancestors are not included, it cannot be called joining.

sentences.zh: 二謂兩主宜毀而瘞之，臣不謂可。

translations.literal: Second, the two lords should be destroyed and buried—I do not say this is acceptable.
translations.idiomatic: Second, the two lords should be destroyed and buried—I do not say this is acceptable.

sentences.zh: 禮，天子七廟、一壇、一墠，遷主皆藏於祧，雖百代不毀。

translations.literal: Ritual: the Son of Heaven has seven temples, one altar, one open ground; moved lords are all stored in tiao—though a hundred generations they are not destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual: the Son of Heaven has seven temples, one altar, one open ground; moved lords are all stored in tiao—though a hundred generations they are not destroyed.

sentences.zh: 祫則太廟享焉。

translations.literal: At he the Grand Temple receives offerings.
translations.idiomatic: At he the Grand Temple receives offerings.

sentences.zh: 魏晉以來，始有毀瘞之議，不見於經。

translations.literal: From Wei and Jin onward there began deliberation on destruction and burial—not seen in the classics.
translations.idiomatic: From Wei and Jin onward there began deliberation on destruction and burial—not seen in the classics.

sentences.zh: 唐家立九廟，以周制推之，獻、懿猶在壇墠，可毀瘞而不禘祫乎？

translations.literal: Tang established nine temples; pushing by Zhou institution, Xian and Yi are still at altar and open ground—can they be destroyed and buried yet not di and he offered?
translations.idiomatic: Tang established nine temples; pushing by Zhou institution, Xian and Yi are still at altar and open ground—can they be destroyed and buried yet not di and he offered?

sentences.zh: 三謂二祖之主宜各遷諸陵，臣不謂可。

translations.literal: Third, the two ancestors' tablets should each move to their tombs—I do not say this is acceptable.
translations.idiomatic: Third, the two ancestors' tablets should each move to their tombs—I do not say this is acceptable.

sentences.zh: 二祖享太廟二百年，一日遷之，恐眷顧依違，不即享於下國。

translations.literal: The two ancestors have been offered in the Grand Temple two hundred years—to move them in one day fears lingering attachment and hesitation, not immediately offering in the lower realm.
translations.idiomatic: The two ancestors have been offered in the Grand Temple two hundred years—to move them in one day fears lingering attachment and hesitation, not immediately offering in the lower realm.

sentences.zh: 四謂宜奉主祔興聖廟而不禘祫，臣不謂可。

translations.literal: Fourth, tablets should be enshrined in the Xingsheng Temple without di and he—I do not say this is acceptable.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, tablets should be enshrined in the Xingsheng Temple without di and he—I do not say this is acceptable.

sentences.zh: 禮，『祭如在』。

translations.literal: Ritual: sacrifice as if present.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual: 'sacrifice as if present.'

sentences.zh: 景皇帝雖太祖，於獻、懿，子孫也。

translations.literal: Jingdi though Grand Ancestor to Xian and Yi is descendant.
translations.idiomatic: Jingdi though Grand Ancestor to Xian and Yi is descendant.

sentences.zh: 今引子東向，廢父之祭，不可謂典。

translations.literal: Now placing the son facing east and abolishing the father's sacrifice—this cannot be called canonical.
translations.idiomatic: Now placing the son facing east and abolishing the father's sacrifice—this cannot be called canonical.

sentences.zh: 五謂獻、懿宜別立廟京師，臣不謂可。

translations.literal: Fifth, Xian and Yi should separately establish temples in the capital—I do not say this is acceptable.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, Xian and Yi should separately establish temples in the capital—I do not say this is acceptable.

sentences.zh: 凡禮有降有殺，故去廟為祧，去祧為壇，去壇為墠，去墠為鬼，漸而遠者，祭益希。

translations.literal: All ritual has lowering and gradation; therefore leaving temple becomes tiao, leaving tiao becomes altar, leaving altar becomes open ground, leaving open ground becomes ghost—gradually more distant, sacrifice more rare.
translations.idiomatic: All ritual has lowering and gradation; therefore leaving temple becomes tiao, leaving tiao becomes altar, leaving altar becomes open ground, leaving open ground becomes ghost—gradually more distant, sacrifice more rare.

sentences.zh: 昔魯立煬宮，《春秋》非之，謂不當取已毀之廟、既藏之主，復築宮以祭。

translations.literal: In the past Lu established the Yang Palace—the Spring and Autumn Annals censured it, saying one should not take already destroyed temples and already stored lords and rebuild a palace to sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the past Lu established the Yang Palace—the Spring and Autumn Annals censured it, saying one should not take already destroyed temples and already stored lords and rebuild a palace to sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 今議正同，故臣皆不謂可。

translations.literal: Today's deliberation is exactly the same—therefore I all say not acceptable.
translations.idiomatic: Today's deliberation is exactly the same—therefore I all say not acceptable.

sentences.zh: 古者殷祖玄王，周祖後稷，太祖之上，皆自為帝。

translations.literal: In antiquity Yin's ancestor Xuanwang, Zhou's ancestor Hou Ji—above the Grand Ancestor all were emperors in their own right.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity Yin's ancestor Xuanwang, Zhou's ancestor Hou Ji—above the Grand Ancestor all were emperors in their own right.

sentences.zh: 又世數已遠，不復祭之，故始祖得東向也。

translations.literal: Moreover generations were already distant and sacrifice ceased—therefore the founding ancestor could face east.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover generations were already distant and sacrifice ceased—therefore the founding ancestor could face east.

sentences.zh: 景皇帝雖太祖，於獻、懿，子孫也。

translations.literal: Jingdi though Grand Ancestor to Xian and Yi is descendant.
translations.idiomatic: Jingdi though Grand Ancestor to Xian and Yi is descendant.

sentences.zh: 當禘祫，獻祖居東向位，景從昭若穆，是祖以孫尊，孫以祖屈，神道人情，其不相遠。

translations.literal: At di and he the Xian ancestor occupies the east-facing position; Jing follows zhao or mu—the ancestor is exalted through the grandson, the grandson bends through the ancestor; spirit Way and human feeling are not far apart.
translations.idiomatic: At di and he the Xian ancestor occupies the east-facing position; Jing follows zhao or mu—the ancestor is exalted through the grandson, the grandson bends through the ancestor; spirit Way and human feeling are not far apart.

sentences.zh: 又常祭眾，合祭寡，則太祖所屈少，而所伸多。

translations.literal: Moreover regular sacrifices are many, joint sacrifices few—then the Grand Ancestor bends little and extends much.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover regular sacrifices are many, joint sacrifices few—then the Grand Ancestor bends little and extends much.

sentences.zh: 與其伸孫尊，廢祖祭，不以順乎？」

translations.literal: Compared with extending the grandson's honor and abolishing the ancestor's sacrifice—is this not compliant?
translations.idiomatic: Compared with extending the grandson's honor and abolishing the ancestor's sacrifice—is this not compliant?"

sentences.zh: 冕又上《禘祫義證》十四篇，帝詔尚書省會百官、國子儒官，明定可否。

translations.literal: Mian again submitted fourteen chapters of Evidential Meaning on Di and He; the emperor ordered the Ministry of Personnel to assemble all officials and National University Confucian officers to clarify what could or could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: Mian again submitted fourteen chapters of Evidential Meaning on Di and He; the emperor ordered the Ministry of Personnel to assemble all officials and National University Confucian officers to clarify what could or could not be done.

sentences.zh: 左司郎中陸淳奏：「按《禮》及諸儒議，復太祖之位，正也。

translations.literal: Director of the Left Bureau Lu Chun submitted: According to the Rites and various Confucians' deliberation, restoring the Grand Ancestor's position is correct.
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Left Bureau Lu Chun submitted: "According to the Rites and various Confucians' deliberation, restoring the Grand Ancestor's position is correct.

sentences.zh: 太祖位正，則獻、懿二主宜有所安。

translations.literal: When the Grand Ancestor's position is correct, the Xian and Yi tablets should have a place to rest.
translations.idiomatic: When the Grand Ancestor's position is correct, the Xian and Yi tablets should have a place to rest.

sentences.zh: 今議者有四：曰藏夾室，曰置別廟，曰各遷於園，曰祔興聖廟。

translations.literal: Today's debaters have four: store in side chambers, establish separate temples, each move to gardens, enshrine in Xingsheng Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Today's debaters have four: store in side chambers, establish separate temples, each move to gardens, enshrine in Xingsheng Temple.

sentences.zh: 臣謂藏夾室，則享獻無期，非周人藏二祧之義；

translations.literal: I say storing in side chambers then offering to Xian has no term—not Zhou people's meaning of storing two tiao.
translations.idiomatic: I say storing in side chambers then offering to Xian has no term—not Zhou people's meaning of storing two tiao;

sentences.zh: 置別廟，論始曹魏，《禮》無傳焉，司馬晉議而不用；

translations.literal: establishing separate temples began with Cao Wei—no transmission in the Rites; Jin deliberated but did not use.
translations.idiomatic: establishing separate temples began with Cao Wei—no transmission in the Rites; Jin deliberated but did not use;

sentences.zh: 遷諸園，亂宗廟之制。

translations.literal: moving to gardens disorders ancestral temple institution.
translations.idiomatic: moving to gardens disorders ancestral temple institution.

sentences.zh: 唯祔興聖廟，禘若祫一祭，庶乎得禮。」

translations.literal: Only enshrining in Xingsheng Temple with di or he one sacrifice—perhaps obtains ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Only enshrining in Xingsheng Temple with di or he one sacrifice—perhaps obtains ritual."

sentences.zh: 帝依違未決也。

translations.literal: The emperor wavered undecided.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wavered undecided.

sentences.zh: 十九年，將禘祭，京復奏禘祭大合祖宗，必尊太祖位，正昭穆。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year di sacrifice was imminent; Jing again submitted that di sacrifice greatly joins ancestors and lords—must honor the Grand Ancestor's position and correct zhao-mu.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year di sacrifice was imminent; Jing again submitted that di sacrifice greatly joins ancestors and lords—must honor the Grand Ancestor's position and correct zhao-mu.

sentences.zh: 請詔百官議。

translations.literal: I request an edict ordering officials to debate.
translations.idiomatic: I request an edict ordering officials to debate.

sentences.zh: 尚書左僕射姚南仲等請奉獻、懿主祔德明、興聖廟。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel Yao Nanzhong and others requested enshrining Xian and Yi in the Deming and Xingsheng temples.
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel Yao Nanzhong and others requested enshrining Xian and Yi in the Deming and Xingsheng temples.

sentences.zh: 鴻臚卿王權、申衍之曰：「周人祖文王，宗武王，故《詩·清廟》章曰：『祀文王也。』

translations.literal: Director of Ceremonials Wang Quan and Shen Yan said: Zhou people took King Wen as ancestor and King Wu as lineage-lord; therefore the Pure Temple ode says: Sacrificing to King Wen.
translations.idiomatic: Director of Ceremonials Wang Quan and Shen Yan said: "Zhou people took King Wen as ancestor and King Wu as lineage-lord; therefore the Pure Temple ode says: 'Sacrificing to King Wen.

sentences.zh: 胡不言太王、王季？

translations.literal: Why not speak of Grand King and King Ji?
translations.idiomatic: Why not speak of Grand King and King Ji?

sentences.zh: 則太王、王季而上，皆祔後稷，故清廟得祀文王也。

translations.literal: Grand King and King Ji upward all enshrined in Hou Ji's temple—therefore Pure Temple could sacrifice to King Wen.
translations.idiomatic: Grand King and King Ji upward all enshrined in Hou Ji's temple—therefore Pure Temple could sacrifice to King Wen.

sentences.zh: 太王、王季之尊，私禮也；

translations.literal: Grand King and King Ji's honor was private ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Grand King and King Ji's honor was private ritual;

sentences.zh: 祔後稷廟，不敢以私奪公也。

translations.literal: enshrining in Hou Ji's temple dared not use private to seize public.
translations.idiomatic: enshrining in Hou Ji's temple dared not use private to seize public.

sentences.zh: 古者先王遷廟主，以昭穆合藏於祖廟。

translations.literal: In antiquity former kings moved temple tablets and by zhao-mu jointly stored them in the ancestor temple.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity former kings moved temple tablets and by zhao-mu jointly stored them in the ancestor temple.

sentences.zh: 獻、懿主宜祔興聖廟，則太祖東向得其尊，獻、懿主歸得其所。」

translations.literal: Xian and Yi tablets should enshrine in Xingsheng Temple—then the Grand Ancestor facing east obtains honor and Xian and Yi tablets return to their place.
translations.idiomatic: Xian and Yi tablets should enshrine in Xingsheng Temple—then the Grand Ancestor facing east obtains honor and Xian and Yi tablets return to their place."

sentences.zh: 是時，言祔興聖廟什七八，天子尚猶豫未剛定。

translations.literal: At that time seven or eight tenths spoke of enshrining in Xingsheng Temple; the Son of Heaven still hesitated without firm decision.
translations.idiomatic: At the time seven or eight tenths spoke of enshrining in Xingsheng Temple; the Son of Heaven still hesitated without firm decision.

sentences.zh: 至是，群臣稍顯言二祖本追崇，非有受命開國之鴻構；

translations.literal: By then officials gradually stated clearly the two ancestors were originally posthumously honored—not having received the mandate and founding the state's great structure.
translations.idiomatic: By then officials gradually stated clearly the two ancestors were originally posthumously honored—not having received the mandate and founding the state's great structure.

sentences.zh: 又權根援《詩》、《禮》明白。

translations.literal: Moreover Quan's citations from the Odes and Rites were clear.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Quan's citations from the Odes and Rites were clear.

sentences.zh: 帝泮然，於是定遷二祖於興聖廟，凡禘祫一享。

translations.literal: The emperor was moved; thereupon it was decided to move the two ancestors to Xingsheng Temple—all di and he one offering.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was moved; thereupon it was decided to move the two ancestors to Xingsheng Temple—all di and he one offering.

translations.literal: Kangzuo because eunuch power was then strong dared not reply; the emperor smiled and dropped the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Kangzuo because eunuch power was then strong dared not reply; the emperor smiled and dropped the matter.

sentences.zh: 後觀書蓬萊殿，召李訓問之，對曰：「古閽寺，今宦人也。

translations.literal: Later viewing books in Penglai Hall he summoned Li Xun to ask; Xun replied: In antiquity gatekeepers, today palace attendants.
translations.idiomatic: Later viewing books in Penglai Hall he summoned Li Xun to ask; Xun replied: "In antiquity gatekeepers, today palace attendants.

sentences.zh: 君不近刑臣，以為輕死之道，孔子書之以為戒。」

translations.literal: The lord does not approach punished ministers—regarding it as the way of treating death lightly; Confucius wrote it as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: The lord does not approach punished ministers—regarding it as the way of treating death lightly; Confucius wrote it as a warning."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「朕邇刑臣多矣，得不慮哉！」

translations.literal: The emperor said: I have lately had many punished ministers—can I not worry!
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "I have lately had many punished ministers—can I not worry!"

sentences.zh: 訓曰：「列聖知而不能遠，惡而不能去，陛下念之，宗廟福也。」

translations.literal: Xun said: The successive sages knew yet could not keep distant, hated yet could not remove—Your Majesty mindful of this is fortune for the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: Xun said: "The successive sages knew yet could not keep distant, hated yet could not remove—Your Majesty mindful of this is fortune for the ancestral temple."

sentences.zh: 於是內謀剪除矣。

translations.literal: Thereupon inner plotting to cut them off began.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon inner plotting to cut them off began.

sentences.zh: 康佐知帝指，因辭疾，罷為兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: Kangzuo knowing the emperor's intent therefore pleaded illness and was dismissed as Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Kangzuo knowing the emperor's intent therefore pleaded illness and was dismissed as Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 遷禮部尚書。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈吏部，謚曰懿。

translations.literal: He died and was posthumously appointed to the Ministry of Personnel with posthumous title Resolute.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously appointed to the Ministry of Personnel with posthumous title Resolute.

sentences.zh: 諸弟皆擢進士第，而堯佐最先進，又舉宏辭，為太子校書郎。

translations.literal: All younger brothers were selected in the jinshi examination; Yao Zuo entered first and also passed the grand composition examination, serving as Proofreader to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: All younger brothers were selected in the jinshi examination; Yao Zuo entered first and also passed the grand composition examination, serving as Proofreader to the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 八年，康佐繼之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Kangzuo followed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Kangzuo followed.

sentences.zh: 堯佐位諫議大夫。

translations.literal: Yao Zuo reached Remonstrance Grand Master.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Zuo reached Remonstrance Grand Master.
